name: prompt-coach
description: Reviews each prompt before it is sent, against Anthropic's prompting guidance for the session's model and effort level. Coach mode shows the findings and lets you choose; auto mode applies them.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: coach: show the review and let me choose. auto: apply it without asking. off: do nothing.

auto_style.title: Auto mode style
auto_style.description: append: leave my words as typed and attach notes only Claude reads. rewrite: replace my prompt with the improved version.

pass_score.title: Pass score
pass_score.description: Coach mode sends a prompt without asking when it scores at least this much (0-100).

backend.title: Review backend
backend.description: session: review through Claude Code's own connection (your plan, API key or cloud provider). api_key: review through the Messages API with the key below.

engine.title: Session review engine
engine.description: fork: the session's own model reviews with the whole conversation in view, reusing its prompt cache. complete: a separate call that sees only a digest of the conversation.

fork_effort.title: Effort of a fork review
fork_effort.description: low: the review asks for low effort, the quickest. session: it names no level and runs at the session's; choose this when your model or provider takes effort for a whole request only, where a different level writes the conversation to the prompt cache again.

review_model.title: Review model
review_model.description: Model for the complete engine and the api_key backend: session (the model the session runs), haiku, sonnet, opus, fable, or a full model id.

api_key.title: Anthropic API key
api_key.description: Used only by the api_key backend. The PROMPT_COACH_API_KEY environment variable works too.

api_base_url.title: API base URL
api_base_url.description: Where the api_key backend sends requests.

timeout_seconds.title: Review timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: When a review takes longer than this, the prompt is sent as typed.

min_chars.title: Shortest prompt to review
min_chars.description: Prompts shorter than this many characters skip the model review. The instant pattern check still runs.

fork_max_tokens.title: Largest conversation to fork
fork_max_tokens.description: Past this many context tokens the review uses the complete engine, so its cost stops growing with the conversation.

headless.title: Review prompts from claude -p and the SDK
headless.description: Off by default: only prompts typed at the prompt box are reviewed. Coach mode never holds a headless prompt.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Language of the card, the notes in the transcript and the command output.
